title: Saltglass Cavern: The Cartographer's Resonance Tablet
premise: In a crystalline underworld cut by migratory subterranean rivers, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Resonance Tablet and return with the charted evacuation line; Cavern Chorus can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive shard bloom while evading the mineral sentinel without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Cavern Chorus to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
